Glossary / Guarantor
Glossary · Banking and bonds

Guarantor गारंटर

A person who promises to repay a loan if the borrower fails to, and who becomes liable in that case.

हिंदी में: गारंटर

वह व्यक्ति जो वादा करता है कि कर्ज़दार न चुका सके तो वह चुकाएगा, और तब वही ज़िम्मेदार होता है।

How it is used in the lessons

If you stand guarantor for someone, their loan can become your responsibility and can affect your credit score.

From Personal Finance: Manage Your Money
